main_text.p: dit: III viros constituendæ philosophiæ, sine dubio diuinitus excitatos. Quorū in sinu & gremio cùm fuerit hic de quo loquimur educatus, nec dubium, nec mirum est eam ipsum scientiæ βαθύτητα esse consecutū, eam scribendi facultatem adeptum, vt nihil vnquam sit ab eo profectum, quod nō visum sit studiosis sapientiæ omnibus numeris perfectum. Testes sunt huius tātæ illius præstātiæ, cùm alia hominis monumenta, quæ in studiosorū manibus, hodiéque versantur: tum hic quoque liber aut libri potiùs ἀπαταρμάτιον[?], quod me auctore atque interprete in tuam se clientelam, si pateris BRVLARDE clarissime, gestit

page.notes: Long s has been read as a plain s throughout. The Greek word in the text ("ἀπαταρμάτιον") is uncertain and is marked [?]. The Greek "βαθύτητα" is copied as read, but the scan is small, so check it. "BRVLARDE" is set in small capitals and is copied as printed. The first line is a fragment continuing from the previous page. Page number and running head are not printed.
